proposal.summary: SolarView Compact ver.6.00 contains a command injection vulnerability in conf_mail.php.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the conf_mail.php proof-of-concept or exploit details to confirm the injection vector, reproduce the issue on a test instance of SolarView Compact 6.00, and identify input validation/sanitization gaps; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure with the vendor and prepare mitigations or patches.

evidence_quotes.quote: SolarView Compact ver.6.00 was discovered to contain a command injection vulnerability via conf_mail.php.
